transcript_path_note: Identical in print and interactive mode. Always the brain/ form; no workspace-local transcript (the form AGY's embedded docs name) is ever created (re-confirmed; the embedded-doc form stays disproven).

layout.~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/brain/<CONVERS: append-only, complete: full tool-result content (tool output itself capped by AGY at ~8 KiB with a '<truncated N bytes>' marker), native-typed tool_calls[].args. The file transcriptPath names. THE PARSER INPUT.
token-efficient twin: content capped at ~4 KiB with 'truncated_fields': ['content'], tool_calls[].args values JSON-string-encoded. Same step_index set.
byte-identical copies of the parent file in every probed conversation (largest 10,751 bytes); a second chunk never opened during Gate 0, so the rollover threshold is unobserved.
layout.<AGY_APP_DATA>/conversations/<CONVERSATI: SQLite (+ -wal/-shm) conversation store; the 1.0.x '.pb' file no longer exists.
layout.~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/brain/<CONVERS: artifact directories; plan-mode plans are written as brain/<CONVERSATION_ID>/<name>.md (+ .metadata.json).

file_exists_at_first_pre_invocation: not directly observable from the hook (no stat at hook time); transcriptPath arrives on the very first PreInvocation (invocationNum 0, initialNumSteps 1) of a brand-new conversation, i.e. before any model step is appended.
disproven: Typed tool records (RUN_COMMAND, VIEW_FILE, MCP_TOOL, LIST_DIRECTORY, GREP_SEARCH, SEARCH_WEB, CODE_ACTION) no longer appear on 1.1.18: every tool result is source=MODEL type=GENERIC with free-text content. The last RUN_COMMAND record on this machine is dated 2026-08-03 (1.1.10).

exit_code is no longer a structured field. The shell outcome is the sentence 'The command exited with code N.' inside GENERIC.content; the tool name and args live only in the preceding PLANNER_RESPONSE.tool_calls[].
